enemy.name: Thalebeast
enemy.flavour_text: A mossback beast covered in thale, a plant native to Arsalan that is highly sensitive to environmental changes. This allows the Thalebeast to predict shifts in the weather.

abilities.text: During <Thunderstorm> and <Thunderburst>, always draws thunder strikes to the tiles it passes through while itself is immune to thunder strike damage.
During <Scorching Sun> and <Bright Sun>, attacks inflict a certain percentage of ATK as Burn. Allied units within a certain range also take extra damage when Burn bursts.
Gains Invisibility and increased attack range in <Sandstorm> and <Great Sandstorm>.
